messages:
Sasha: automated sentinel flagged a stale-config situation in eu-west1 GPU pool :rotating_light: — desired node count in config doesn't match what's running
Alex: ugh, that region has been tight this week. what did the detector find exactly?
Sasha: summary: infra config shows 8 GPU nodes for `nodepool/gpu-eu-west1` but k8s reports 5 ready. helm values vs cluster state mismatch. autoscaler policy also different (min=4 in cluster, min=6 in repo)
Priya: could be a partial rollback during the midnight helm rollout. any recent helm releases? @Jamie did you see something?
Jamie: I triggered a canary last night for the gpu-quant changes, but it shouldn't touch nodepools. logs show the gitops sync failed on preflight and then skipped the nodepool apply because of quota check :thinking_face:
Sasha: here's the quick output from the sentinel probe:
```
--- repo/values/gpu-eu-west1.yaml
replicas: 8
autoscaler:
  minReplicas: 6
  maxReplicas: 12
--- cluster (kubectl)
readyReplicas: 5
autoscaler:
  minReplicas: 4
```
\nNate: also seeing nodepool has a taint mismatch, cluster nodes carry `dedicated=redwood:NoSchedule` but repo expects `dedicated=inference:NoSchedule` — that could prevent scale-up hooks from scheduling the GPU instances
Alex: opsbot, did any cloud quota events show for eu-west1 in the last 24h?
OpsBot: cloud-events: 3 quota alerts in eu-west1 GPU family in last 24h. Highest at 2024-11-18T03:12Z — capacity shortage triggered spot-fallback to us-west-2.
Priya: spot fallback explains why we see cross-region scheduling and a cost blip. need to avoid cross-region fallbacks for dedicated pools.
Jamie: quick mitigation: pin nodepool to `preferredZones: [eu-west-1a, eu-west-1b]` and set `policy: failOnInsufficientCapacity` in the pool config, then create a patch PR to repo.
Sasha: agree. also want a reconciler rule to fail the gitops sync if nodepool count drift > 1 and autoscaler min differs from repo. this should surface before rollouts. :white_check_mark:
Alex: can we run a dry terraform plan against the tfstate to show intended -> actual delta? I can run in ~15m.
Nate: I'll gather the `kubectl get nodes` and `kubectl describe hpa` outputs and post here for the patch PR. quick snippet: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-eu --no-headers | wc -l` -> 5
Priya: cost note — patch should include a fallback policy to prefer regional capacity and throttle cross-region failovers; raise a ticket with Finance for the unexpected egress cost from last night.
Sasha: thanks team. action items: Alex will run tf plan and open PR, Jamie will add preflight policy in gitops, Nate will attach cluster facts, Priya will file cost ticket. OpsBot will post quota alerts to #incidents if threshold 2+ in 1h.
Alex: starting plan now, will paste plan summary when done.
OpsBot: reminder — next automated parity scan scheduled in 1h.
